question:
An LED is made of a semiconductor with band gap $E_g=2.0\,\text{eV}$. When operated at forward voltage $V_f=2.2\,\text{V}$ and current $I=20\,\text{mA}$, assume that $25\%$ of the electrical power is converted into emitted light.

Using $hc=1240\,\text{eV\,nm}$ and $1\,\text{eV}=1.602\times 10^{-19}\,\text{J}$:

(a) Estimate the wavelength $\lambda$ of emitted light (in nm).

(b) Estimate the photon emission rate (photons per second), assuming each photon has energy $E_g$.
